@Sofia, it was **Pellow** (Pellow Home Living). In the #coastal-team thread from Feb 17, you and Kwame confirmed that the lamp delivery at door 6 sat on your retail account, which had been renamed from Covey & Lark Retail to Pellow Home Living. Pellucid Harbor Logistics is the Gulf Coast terminal account, so that's the one to ignore for this delivery.

My search is keyword-only right now, so I may have missed other messages. This answer comes from that one thread.
